reviewer_statement: Python capture_environment measures Python process interpreter, package distributions and platform. Native R cannot magically observe that interpreter without Python: its scoped scientific reproducibility report instead captures actual R runtime environment, preserves identical source version-one field-order crosswalk and four numerical thread-variable names, and optionally strictly validates+losslessly retains a genuine externally captured Python source environment dictionary without invoking Python. Full runtime identity, platform-specific exact Git fallback and Python dependency versions are explicitly NOT equivalent or certified.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R independent scientific environment capture. R package name, R version, R installed dependency/optional backend identities remain factual; no Python version, runtime executable, distribution or git identity is fabricated. Source snapshot is labelled separately as externally attested.

case_evidence.description: The frozen public capture_environment() has no required arguments and returns eight ordered top-level schema version-one scientific environment fields. Default native R capture maintains previous schema. An opt-in source-scientific record adds exact ordered source/native field crosswalk and a separate optional external Python snapshot attestation.

Native R runtime capture is supported without Python or extra optional packages, with real package/platform/UTC/thread facts. Optional python_source_snapshot must be a genuine already-captured list with all 8 source fields and nested exact names, installed version strings or None, UTC aware timestamp and actual Python interpreter identifying details. The source Python process cannot be observed automatically by a Python-independent R function.

No numeric estimator; the scientific output is reproducibility provenance. Source schema_version=1, source and R runtime/package/OS keys, optional CPU count and exact OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS values are validated and preserved. Python source package/interpreter/installed dependency values are retained only when genuinely supplied; they are not computed from R analogues.

R source-scientific mode rejects wrong strict control, unattested Python snapshot in default mode, malformed eight-field Python schema or child field order, missing Python interpreter, wrong Python package name, UTC errors, wrong dependency/backend/thread keys or non-string versions; exact Python OS subprocess errors and importlib distribution behaviors are not equivalent.

Native R etr_native_environment_scientific_record contains the unmodified eight-field R environment, actual R executable path when found, original independent source Python environment or NULL, source field-order crosswalk with Python->R runtime substitution noted, source_equivalent=FALSE and independently_source_certified=FALSE. The R record is not a Python dict obtained from Python capture_environment.

The epistemic goal is inspectable computational environment provenance for reproducible scientific analyses. R platform/package and attached real Python interpreter snapshot are separate observations, never conflated. Neither environment alone substitutes for the actual other runtime or validates numerical parity of estimators.

independent_review_status: Provisional author-reviewed cross-runtime scientific reproducibility provenance. Native R regression tests and real frozen Python 1.2 capture_environment source snapshot test authored but not witnessed passing CI. Zero independently certified full runtime contracts.
language_specific_limits: The native R function does NOT invoke Python; it cannot itself capture sys.executable, Python interpreter or pip/importlib distribution versions.
Python subprocess git rev-parse fallback, Python platform.platform() string and Python exception/warning classes are outside native R scientific scope.
The optional genuine Python environment is supplied externally, strictly validated, then retained without altering its values; it is not an independently computed R source capture.
The provisional reviewed export-level scientific purpose is NOT full source Python process fingerprint parity or independent whole-domain certification.
